Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 3, Verse 38

“As fire is covered by smoke, as a mirror by dust, and as an embryo by the womb, so is this covered by that.”

Three images of increasing intimacy — smoke drifts off, dust wipes away, but the womb cannot simply be removed. Krishna is grading how deeply desire can be embedded.
